title: Sumitomo Chemical fixes record date for ₹1.3 dividend Sumitomo Chemical India Limited announced July 17, 2026, as the record date for a ₹1.30 per share dividend for FY26, pending shareholder approval. Shriram Finance Revises Upward India's Tractor and Farm Equipment Wholesale Volume Growth Forecast to 15-17% for FY27 Shriram Finance has revised its FY27 growth forecast for India's tractor and farm equipment wholesale volumes upward to 15-17%, compared to its previous estimate of 8-10%. The revised projection represents a near-doubling of the midpoint of the earlier forecast range. This update reflects a significantly more optimistic outlook for agricultural equipment demand in India for FY27

The Board approved the appointment on recommendations from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and the Audit Committee.
